- TOTAL revenue reached £74.9k in TW versus £48.6k in LW, a WoW gain of 54.19%.

- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT added £1,527.00 WoW (up 36,973.4% WoW), HOT WATER BOTTLE I AM SO POORLY added £1,349.25 WoW and JUMBO BAG ALPHABET added £1,271.76 WoW.
- SET OF TEA COFFEE SUGAR TINS PANTRY fell £1,834.20 WoW, SET OF 3 CAKE TINS PANTRY DESIGN fell £1,052.69 WoW and JUMBO BAG VINTAGE LEAF fell £543.24 WoW.
- SMALL CHINESE STYLE SCISSOR posted the largest percentage move at 157,681.0% WoW.
